title: Mirano Pay
tagline: Multi-chain trusted payment ecosystem for LATAM ---------------
description: Problem: Latin American countries receive 13% of their GDP in Cross-boarder payments but the current solutions are: Archaic (middle mans), Slow ( Days or Weeks) , Expensive ( 5- 35% fees), Untraceable ( How is money spent).   Our Solution: A two sided ecosystem that promotes for User: Receive and Send Instant Payments, Extreme low fees, Secure and traceable. For Merchants: Immediate settlements, Faster Transactions, Mitigation for Devaluation. Please check pitch deck for LATAM IMPACT.
how_its_made: Our product has the following features:  Send stablecoins in multiple blockchains: ETH, OPTIMISM, SKALE, BOBA and POLYGON. User has the send crypto and select the categories where he wants the receiver to spend the money. Using superfluid for Automated recurrent payments. Swivel for atractive saving mechanisms. Radicle is where our code is stored. We connect our wallet with wallet connect. Use Privy as our database for merchant information and Tenderly as our smart contract debugging tool. Worldcoin as our user validator , and Tatum as our deployer.
